biotools.summary: Tools for 1D NMR metabolomics workflows, including import and preprocessing of Bruker experiments, multivariate modeling (PCA, PLS, OPLS) and model analytics and validation (y-permutations, cv-anova). Performance-critical routines are implemented in C++ and use the Armadillo and Eigen linear algebra libraries to improve runtime.
